1_0_20: Automatic updates install themselves. Kensaku downloads signed releases in the background and applies them when the window is hidden or another app has focus, so a restart never interrupts what you are doing.
The status bar now shows the whole update: the download percentage, the restart countdown, and a waiting-for-indexing state.
Memory after a large crawl falls back to a small floor instead of holding the crawl's peak. The allocator returns big image buffers, and OCR engines are released two minutes after a crawl ends.
Grid thumbnails decode two at a time, so browsing during a crawl no longer multiplies memory use.
Deleted and renamed files now drop their semantic and visual entries, not just their metadata.
